According to the search results, **Season 2 Episode 12 titled "Gorizilla"** aired on **March 14, 2018** in Canada on Family Channel, and on **March 30, 2018** in the USA on Netflix.

- Episode 12 (production code 210): **"Gorizilla"**
- Episode 13 (production code 216): **"Captain Hardrock"**
